statusText: Mapped policy state: EA_ON. Tail 10 is in the low band, well below the block threshold, while Stress 47 is elevated on the U.S. cash open and Friday's scheduled Jackson Hole keynote.
recommendation: Conditions are described as mean-reversion-friendly: the overnight range has been unextended for about three hours and an earlier post-earnings spike was fully retraced. The narrow danger window spans 12:30Z to 15:00Z, covering the weekly claims digestion and the first cash hour.
headline: NQ holds near 29,580 with the overnight range unextended for three hours: Tail steady at 10, Stress 47 as the 12:30Z claims print lands
body: Nasdaq-100 September futures trade at 29,574.25 on Yahoo Finance and 29,584.25 on Investing.com, both quotes timed near 12:15Z, up roughly 285 to 295 points or about 1.0% against a previous close of 29,289.50. Both references show the same overnight range of 29,401.75 to 29,660.50, with the second printing a high of 29,662.00. The structural observation is that the range has now been unextended for roughly three hours: price sits some 80 to 90 points below the session high, and the post-earnings spike toward 29,660 earlier in the overnight session was fully retraced to 29,401.75 before the current recovery. That is two-sided behaviour rather than the persistent no-retracement path that Tail measures, which is why Tail stays at 10 despite a one-percent gap. Cross-assets are not aligned behind the equity move. VIX is 14.94, down 1.78% from a 15.21 close, in a narrow 14.80 to 15.06 range. The H.15 release shows the 2Y at 4.17% and the 10Y at 4.64% as of 25 August, both lower on the day and stabilised after last week's spike. WTI is flat near $82.23 and Brent is $88.17, up 0.37%, with no energy discontinuity. Leadership is narrow rather than broad: Reuters reports Nasdaq-100 e-minis up 0.97% while Dow e-minis were down 0.08%, with Nvidia up 7.2% pre-market after guiding third-quarter revenue to about $108 billion, alongside Salesforce up 11.6% and CrowdStrike up 9.5%. Narrow leadership against a flat broad tape is a conflict signal, and under the standing contract conflict raises Stress and lowers conviction rather than mechanically raising Tail. Two limitations are recorded. The weekly jobless-claims release lands at 12:30Z, effectively at the assessment cutoff, and two calendar providers disagree on the outcome, so no actual figure is treated as verified here. The freshest verified quote also predates that release by roughly fifteen minutes, so the immediate post-release price path is not observed. Both limitations are reflected in Confidence at 82 rather than in Tail. The shared Finviz context file carries a generatedAt of 02:15Z, more than ninety minutes old, so it is treated as stale under the inherited contract and this assessment rests on independent research. The danger window is kept narrow at 12:30Z to 15:00Z, covering the claims digestion and the 13:30Z cash open through the first full cash hour, which is where an opening-auction continuation would first become observable.

lookbackSummary: Across the past 24 hourly slots Tail moved between 10 and 21 and Stress between 45 and 66, with 21 of 24 hours carrying a published assessment and three hours unavailable. The window spans the pre-Nvidia drift through 26 August, the single watch-band hour at 20:00Z covering the results release, and the steady decay across the Asian and European sessions as the initial repricing was absorbed. Dominant mode moved from event/whipsaw around the release back to mixed once two-sided trade returned, and the mapped policy state was EA_ON for every available hour except that one watch-band slot.
outlookSummary: The forward path keeps the mapped state at EA_ON for 22 of the next 24 hours and lifts Tail into the watch band only at 13:00Z and 14:00Z, covering the U.S. cash open and the first full cash hour of Nvidia repricing. Stress peaks at 60 across the opening auction, eases through the U.S. afternoon around the 17:00Z 7-year auction, falls to 37 in the quiet overnight hours, then rebuilds toward 52 by the end of the horizon as Friday's scheduled Jackson Hole keynote approaches. Every forward score is conditional: no post-open or Friday price path is observed at assessment time, and Confidence decays from 82 to 55 across the horizon to reflect that distance.
